orgDesign.companyProfile: Scaled online retail marketplace centered on shopper convenience, marketplace supply, Prime fulfillment, retail media, and platform trust.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Shopper-facing teams own discovery, detail, conversion, and Prime retention. Seller teams own onboarding, catalog, fulfillment, and commercial visibility. Retail media teams own sponsored products, DSP, and measurement. Foundation teams own identity, trust, recommendations, and shared commerce intelligence. Control and evidence accountability: privacy and security controls for identity, accounts, and payment data are operated by trust-and-identity and marketplace-foundations-trust-and-platform-control; compliance and regulatory-evidence duties (INFORM Act, authenticity enforcement, appeals, regulator reporting) sit with trust-and-identity with supporting seller-verification evidence from the seller-platform teams; financial controls for seller payouts, fees, and ledgers are operated by seller-fulfillment as steward of the seller payout ledger; measurement governance (attribution methodology, clean-room and reporting integrity) is operated by measurement-insights. Customer accountability convention: a team's customerDependencies list both direct customers (those working in its owned surfaces) and indirect/materially-affected customers (those whose jobs its bricks materially shape), with each dependency description labeling which relation it represents.

groups.name: Marketplace Foundations
groups.mission: Own identity, trust, authenticity, integrations, recommendations, and shared measurement foundations.

groupDirectHeadcount.description: Provide cross-team direction, portfolio tradeoffs, architecture coherence, and talent quality across Marketplace Foundations.

teams.name: Trust and Identity
teams.description: Own accounts, entitlements, authenticity, abuse prevention, and policy enforcement — a risk-control platform with regulated evidence responsibilities that the rest of the marketplace consumes.

customerDependencies.description: Direct: own the enforcement, authenticity, and policy-decision surfaces the trust/compliance operator works in, including appeal and regulatory-evidence quality.
Direct: provide the fraud/abuse and refund-risk decisions the fulfillment/resolution operator relies on to contain refund leakage and defect abuse.

Indirect (materially affected): auth/risk gate shopper sign-in, account safety, and checkout — false positives here directly hurt Prime shopper conversion and trust even though the operator consoles are the direct surface.
Indirect (materially affected): authenticity and abuse enforcement (auth/risk) decide seller listing suppression, holds, and reinstatement, materially shaping seller livelihood and account health.
Indirect (materially affected): abuse and invalid-traffic controls (risk) protect ad-spend integrity and measurement credibility for advertisers.

brickDependencies.description: Own authenticity and listing-trust enforcement across the marketplace.
Own the fraud, abuse, and policy-control platform consumed by seller, returns, and operator teams.
Consume Brand Registry rights for authenticity enforcement; seller-platform-commercial-control owns the registry.

otherTeamDependencies.description: Consume Brand Registry rights and brand-protection evidence (brick bran) for authenticity enforcement and counterfeit takedowns; recurring policy-review loop.
Consume seller KYC/verification outcomes (brick sell) as inputs to abuse decisioning and INFORM Act evidence; shared regulator-reporting loop.

teams.name: Commerce Intelligence
teams.description: Shared platform team that owns the commerce APIs and external-integration surface (brick apii) consumed across discovery, retail-media, fulfillment, and operator teams. It does not own recommendations (shopper-growth-shared-intelligence-and-integration owns reco) or measurement/reporting (measurement-insights owns anal/repr); it provides the integration and data-access contracts those capabilities are served through.

customerDependencies.description: Personalized discovery and recommendation quality across shopper surfaces.
Measurement, experimentation, and attribution credibility behind advertiser budgets.
Analytics and integration evidence used in trust investigations and regulatory reporting.

streamDependencies.description: Provide the commerce APIs and external integration surface merchants use to run fulfillment through ERP and integrator tooling.

Supporting: the commerce API/integration surface (brick apii) carries partner traffic and integration events that trust enforcement and regulator-evidence flows depend on; trust-and-identity owns the enforcement stream.

brickDependencies.description: Own commerce APIs and external integration surfaces consumed by discovery, retail-media, and measurement teams.

otherTeamDependencies.description: Coordinate partner/integrator access to Brand Registry data through the commerce API surface; policy review on what integration scopes brand-protection data.
Consume seller onboarding/verification state (brick sell) to gate API credentials and integrator access for newly onboarded sellers.

teams.name: Marketplace Foundations Identity, Accounts & Entitlements
teams.description: Own identity, accounts, and entitlements as a shared platform, providing the authentication and authorization backbone the rest of the marketplace builds on.

brickDependencies.description: Own identity, accounts, and entitlements as the shared authn/authz backbone.
